compartment.title: @agentsy/daemon Phase 1 B1-B10+B12: IPC/type fixes → successful build
compartment.p1:
Continued Batch 1 work on `@agentsy/daemon` package (messages 1-42 established the scaffold and Batch 1 scope). Multiple rounds of type-and-build fixes until the package built clean:
IPC handler return types: changed from `Promise<void>` to `Promise<unknown>` to satisfy JSON-RPC handler registry. MemoryEngine type cast issues: memory engine typed as `MemoryEngine` from `@agentsy/memory` but subsystem methods needed `initialize`/`shutdown` — fixed with type assertions. IPC client: fixed `IPCClient` constructor arg order (was passing `socketPath` then `handlers`, needed the reverse). `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` fix: changed `memoryCheckIntervalMs: 0` to `1` — Zod's `positive()` rejects zero. CLI `start.ts`: fixed import of `logger` (was missing). After each fix, rebuilt and watched for `error|Error|success|⚡️` markers.
Final build: **successful** — all 11 entry points, ESM + CJS + DTS. Updated `docs/packages.md` to include `@agentsy/daemon`. User said "proceed" (message 76) to begin writing tests.
compartment.p2: IPC/type fixes across daemon.ts, ipc/client.ts, processes/subprocess-manager.ts, cli/start.ts: handler return types → `Promise<unknown>`, MemoryEngine casts, exactOptionalPropertyTypes (`memoryCheckIntervalMs: 0 → 1`), import corrections. Build successful across all 11 entry points. docs/packages.md updated.
compartment.p3: Phase 1 B1-B10+B12 complete; `@agentsy/daemon` builds clean (ESM + CJS + DTS, 11 entry points).
compartment.p4: build success; 11 entry points; IPC handler fixes; exactOptionalPropertyTypes; memoryCheckIntervalMs

compartment.title: Exhaustive code review of @agentsy/daemon; remediation plan produced
compartment.p1:
User posted the "Exhaustive Code Review Skill" markdown and the agent applied it to `@agentsy/daemon`. Ran automated checks first: build ✅ pass, tests ✅ 18/18 pass, typecheck ❌ FAIL — 60 errors in test files.
Systematic 13-dimension review produced a remediation plan. Key findings:
**MEDIUM severity (2 categories):** 1. Test mock loggers missing `child` property — `Logger` interface requires `child`, all 18 test files create mocks without it, causing 50+ tsc errors. Fix: shared `createMockLogger()` helper. 2. Test config objects missing required fields — `DaemonDeps.config` typed as full `DaemonConfig` (not `Partial`), but tests pass partial objects.
**MEDIUM severity (1 category):** 3. Three `as never`/`as unknown as` casts in `daemon.ts:266,136,198` — IPC `process.spawn` handler and memory engine initialize/shutdown.
**LOW severity (3 items):** unused imports (`createHash`, `randomUUID`) in daemon.ts; missing JSDoc on public APIs; `child` method optionality on Logger interface.
**Verification checklist:** `pnpm --filter @agentsy/daemon check-types` still failing (60 errors). All other gates pass.
Recommendation: **APPROVE AFTER FIXES** — no correctness, security, or performance issues in production code.
U: "commit all changes and open a pr / begin full remediation, then commit all changes and open a pr"
Agent responded with two-step plan: (1) commit Phase 1 as-is and open PR, (2) do full remediation then commit+PR separately. User did not explicitly choose — agent proceeded to begin remediation.
compartment.p2: Exhaustive code review of `@agentsy/daemon` found 60 typecheck errors in test files (missing `child` on mock loggers, partial config objects), three `any`/`never` casts in production daemon.ts, and LOW items (unused imports, missing JSDoc). Remediation plan produced. User requested commit+PR + full remediation. Agent began remediation.
compartment.p3: Code review: 60 typecheck errors in test files (mock logger missing `child`, partial configs), three `as never` casts in daemon.ts. APPROVE AFTER FIXES.
